summary: OSpec 1.8.14 fixes a cross-task multi-review race found in a resumed Mobile Goal. A bounded controller poll can now renew a claimed child for one 60-second wait after the short-lease boundary without weakening direct-result, orphan, or absolute-deadline guards, and unapproved cross-task owner reviews or repairs now precede downstream implementation while other safe reviewers remain parallel.
new: Added fail-closed discovery of cross-task repair owner IDs from frozen retry provenance.
Added a one-bounded-wait controller poll tolerance at the short lease boundary.
improved: Keeps multi-review batches authoritative when one reviewer finishes and a sibling is still live near its lease boundary.
Prioritizes unapproved cross-task owner review and repair without serializing unrelated conflict-safe reviewers.
fixed: Fixed a valid late owner finding losing its original action because scheduling overhead crossed the five-minute lease boundary.
Fixed downstream implementation being emitted before a cross-task owner review or repair had settled.
docs: Documented the Mobile iteration 145/146 incident, bounded renewal policy, recovery path, owner barrier, and unchanged provenance and deadline guards.
